stories.headline: Pentagon Signs Classified AI Deals With Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS, Google, SpaceX, OpenAI, and Reflection

key_facts.fact: The US Department of Defense entered agreements with seven companies — SpaceX, OpenAI, Google, Nvidia, Reflection AI, Microsoft, and Amazon Web Services — to deploy frontier AI on classified networks (IL6 and IL7).
key_facts.excerpt: The War Department has entered into agreements with seven of the world's leading frontier artificial intelligence companies, SpaceX, OpenAI, Google, NVIDIA, Reflection, Microsoft, and Amazon Web Services to deploy their advanced AI capabilities on the Department's classified networks for lawful operational use.

key_facts.fact: The statement describes the effort as accelerating the transformation toward an 'AI-first fighting force' and strengthening warfighter decision superiority across all domains.
key_facts.excerpt: These agreements accelerate the transformation toward establishing the United States military as an AI-first fighting force and will strengthen our warfighters' ability to maintain decision superiority across all domains of warfare.

key_facts.fact: The Pentagon's AI platform GenAI.mil already has over 1.3 million users who have generated tens of millions of prompts and deployed hundreds of thousands of agents in five months.
key_facts.excerpt: GenAI.mil, the War Department's official AI platform, is already demonstrating the scale and impact of this acceleration. Over 1.3 million Department personnel have used the platform, generating tens of millions of prompts and deploying hundreds of thousands of agents in only five months.

key_facts.fact: The Pentagon finalized its agreement with AWS late Thursday; the announcement also marks the first official Pentagon confirmation of a new deal with Google reported earlier this week.
key_facts.excerpt: The Pentagon finalized its agreement with Amazon Web Services late Thursday, according to two Pentagon officials briefed on the discussions... The statement marks the first official Pentagon confirmation of a new deal with Google that was reported earlier this week.

key_facts.fact: The push comes amid a dispute with Anthropic over safeguards on its Claude models, as the Pentagon seeks alternative AI systems for military use.
key_facts.excerpt: Push comes amid a dispute with Anthropic over safeguards on its Claude models, as the Defense Department seeks alternative AI systems for military use.

sources.title: Pentagon signs AI deals with Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS and Reflection
Pentagon signs Nvidia, Microsoft, AWS for classified AI programs

stories.headline: Huawei Expects AI Chip Revenue to Hit ~$12B in 2026, Up 60%+ as Ascend Orders Surge

key_facts.fact: Huawei expects revenue from its AI chips to reach about $12 billion in 2026, up from $7.5 billion in 2025 — a jump of at least 60% — based on orders already received.
key_facts.excerpt: The Chinese tech company expects revenue from its chips to reach about $12 billion this year based on orders it has already received, up from $7.5 billion in 2025, the newspaper said, citing sources.

key_facts.fact: The majority of orders this year are for Huawei's latest Ascend 950PR processor, which entered mass production in March; an upgraded Ascend 950DT is planned for Q4.
key_facts.excerpt: The report said Huawei received majority of orders this year for its latest Ascend processor 950PR, which entered mass production in March, and the firm plans to launch an upgraded version of 950DT in the fourth quarter.

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek's release of its V4 AI model on April 24, optimized for Huawei Ascend chips, triggered a procurement wave from Alibaba, ByteDance, and Tencent.
key_facts.excerpt: The revenue surge has been supercharged by DeepSeek's release of its V4 AI model on April 24, which was specifically optimised to run on Huawei's Ascend chips. The move triggered a wave of procurement activity across China's largest technology companies, with Alibaba, ByteDance, and Tencent among those racing to secure supply.

key_facts.fact: TrendForce forecasts the Chinese high-end AI chip market will grow by more than 60% in 2026, with domestically produced chips potentially capturing around half of that market.
key_facts.excerpt: Analysts at TrendForce forecast the Chinese high-end AI chip market will grow by more than 60% in 2026, with domestically produced chips potentially capturing around half of that market.

key_facts.fact: Huawei's Ascend developer ecosystem now counts more than four million developers; 2025 group revenues were 880.9 billion yuan ($127.8B) with record R&D spending of 192.3 billion yuan.
key_facts.excerpt: Huawei reported group revenues of 880.9 billion yuan ($127.8 billion) for 2025, with record R&D spending of 192.3 billion yuan. Its Ascend developer ecosystem now counts more than four million developers.

stories.headline: Intel Stock Surges 114% in April, Best Month in Chipmaker's 55 Years on Nasdaq

key_facts.fact: Intel shares jumped 114% in April, lifting the chipmaker's market cap past $470 billion — by far the best month in Intel's 55-year history on the Nasdaq (previous best was 70% in July 1973).
key_facts.excerpt: Intel shares jumped 114% in April, lifting the chipmaker's market cap past $470 billion. It was by far the best month in Intel's 55-year history on the Nasdaq, with the best prior month coming in July 1973, when the stock rose 70%.

key_facts.fact: Intel hit a record on April 24 for the first time since 2000, following a blowout earnings report with revenue up 7% to $13.6B — the biggest revenue beat in more than 5 years.
key_facts.excerpt: The stock rose to a record that day for the first time since 2000, and then continued to rise.

key_facts.fact: The rally is driven by Intel's 18A chips showing real promise at its new Arizona plant and surging CPU demand from agentic AI; Bank of America predicts the CPU market could more than double by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Wall Street appears convinced the tide may be turning, with Intel's latest 18A chips showing real promise as they churn out of the company's new Arizona plant. At the same time, agentic AI is spinning up a major resurgence in demand for Intel's core product, the central processing unit. Bank of America predicts the CPU market could more than double by 2030.

key_facts.fact: CEO Lip-Bu Tan said demand for Intel's data center CPU exceeds supply: 'The CPU is reinserting itself as the indispensable foundation of the AI era.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'The CPU is reinserting itself as the indispensable foundation of the AI era,' Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said on the company's earning call last week, adding that demand for its data center CPU exceeds supply.

key_facts.fact: The US government took a 10% stake in Intel in August, becoming its largest shareholder through an $8.9B CHIPS Act investment; that stake is now worth over $40 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: In August, the US government took a 10% stake in the company, becoming its largest shareholder. The Trump administration's $8.9 billion investment largely comes from grants promised under the CHIPS Act signed by President Joe Biden in 2022. This stake is now worth over $40 billion.

stories.headline: SanDisk Q3 Revenue Surges 251% YoY to $5.95B on AI-Driven NAND Demand; Guides Q4 Up to $8.25B

key_facts.fact: SanDisk reported Q3 revenue of $5.95 billion, up 251% YoY and 97% sequentially, crushing the $4.72 billion estimate; adjusted EPS was $23.41 vs. the $14.62 estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: Third quarter revenue was $5.95 billion, up 97% sequentially and above the guidance range, with GAAP net income reported at $3,615 million ($23.03 diluted net income per share).

key_facts.fact: Datacenter revenue surged 233% sequentially; gross margin hit 78.4%, now higher than Nvidia's 75%.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue outperformance was driven by both our mix shift toward higher-value customers, with Datacenter up 233%, and higher pricing.

key_facts.fact: SanDisk guided Q4 revenue of $7.75B–$8.25B with adjusted EPS of $30–$33, far above consensus.
key_facts.excerpt: Expect fourth quarter revenue to be in the range of $7.75 billion to $8.25 billion, with expected Non-GAAP diluted net income per share to be in the range of $30.00 to $33.00.

key_facts.fact: SanDisk has signed three 'New Business Model' agreements with customers for multi-year supply backed by firm financial commitments, with two more signed in Q4.
key_facts.excerpt: Ended the fiscal third quarter with three signed New Business Model ('NBM') agreements. Signed two additional NBM agreements in the fiscal fourth quarter.

key_facts.fact: Western Digital also beat estimates, reporting Q3 revenue of $3.34B (+45% YoY) and EPS of $2.72 (vs. $2.34 est.), guiding Q4 to $3.10–$3.40 EPS, citing AI-driven HDD demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Western Digital reported adjusted third-quarter earnings of $2.72 per share, up from just $1.36 per share a year ago and well above Wall Street's forecast of $2.39 per share. The company's revenue grew 45% from a year earlier, to $3.34 billion, easily beating the analyst consensus estimate of $3.25 billion.

stories.headline: Nebius Acquires Inference Startup Eigen AI for $643M to Bolster Token Factory Platform

key_facts.fact: Nebius agreed to acquire Eigen AI for approximately $643 million in cash and stock to strengthen its Token Factory managed inference platform.
key_facts.excerpt: Nebius (NASDAQ: NBIS), the AI cloud company, today announced an agreement to acquire Eigen AI, a leading inference and model optimization company.

key_facts.fact: Eigen AI's founding team includes MIT HAN Lab researchers; co-founder Ryan Wang's Sparse Attention (SpAtten) work is the most-cited HPCA paper since 2020, and co-founder Wei-Chen Wang received the MLSys 2024 Best Paper Award for AWQ quantization.
key_facts.excerpt: Ryan's pioneering Sparse Attention (SpAtten) work is the most-cited HPCA paper since 2020, while Wei-Chen received the MLSys 2024 Best Paper Award for Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) quantization — now the standard for 4-bit model serving in production deployments.

key_facts.fact: The two companies had already jointly optimized implementations of leading open-source models that ranked among the fastest on Artificial Analysis benchmarks.
key_facts.excerpt: The two companies have already delivered jointly optimized implementations of leading open source models that ranked among the fastest on Artificial Analysis.

key_facts.fact: The acquisition establishes a Nebius engineering and research presence in the San Francisco Bay Area; the deal is expected to close in the coming weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: The acquisition also accelerates Nebius's expansion in the US. Eigen AI's founding team... will join Nebius to establish a Nebius engineering and research presence in the San Francisco Bay Area.

sources.title: Nebius agrees to acquire Eigen AI, strengthening Nebius Token Factory as a frontier inference platform

stories.headline: MARA Acquires Long Ridge Energy for $1.5B, Plans 1GW+ AI Data Center Campus in Ohio

key_facts.fact: MARA Holdings agreed to acquire Long Ridge Energy & Power from FTAI Infrastructure for approximately $1.5 billion (including assumed debt), gaining a 505 MW combined-cycle gas plant in Hannibal, Ohio, and over 1,600 acres of land.
key_facts.excerpt: MARA Holdings, Inc. today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Long Ridge Energy & Power LLC from FTAI Infrastructure Inc. for a total transaction value of approximately $1.5 billion (including the assumption of certain debt). The acquisition includes Long Ridge Energy's highly efficient 505 MW nameplate combined-cycle gas power plant in Hannibal, Ohio, and over 1,600 contiguous acres.

key_facts.fact: The site could support more than 1 GW of total power capacity and increases MARA's owned-and-operated capacity by 65%, expanding its pipeline to roughly 2.2 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Increases MARA's Owned and Operated Capacity by 65%... The acquired campus will provide immediate access to power, land, water and fiber upon closing... and supports more than 1 GW of total potential power capacity across generation and load.

key_facts.fact: MARA plans to begin construction on an initial AI and critical IT buildout in H1 2027, with first capacity targeted for mid-2028; the site has attracted interest from investment-grade AI tenants.
key_facts.excerpt: MARA plans to start construction on an initial AI and critical IT buildout in the first half of 2027, with the first capacity targeted for mid-2028.

key_facts.fact: Long Ridge assets are expected to add approximately $144 million of annualized adjusted EBITDA at less than $15/MWh all-in operating costs.
key_facts.excerpt: Adds Approximately $144 Million of Annualized Adjusted EBITDA at Less than $15/MWh of All-In Operating Costs

key_facts.fact: CEO Fred Thiel: 'Power is the scarce input in AI' — the deal reflects the broader trend of bitcoin miners pivoting to AI data center infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: MARA Holdings (MARA) is acquiring Long Ridge Energy & Power for $1.5 billion to power its AI data center expansion.

stories.headline: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Says AI Chip Substrate Demand Exceeds Capacity by 50%+, Begins Price Hikes

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electro-Mechanics said during its Q1 earnings call that demand for FC-BGA substrates used in AI servers and data centers currently exceeds its production capacity by more than 50%.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electro-Mechanics said during its first-quarter earnings conference call Wednesday that demand for FC-BGA used in AI servers and data centers currently exceeds its production capacity by more than 50%.

key_facts.fact: As AI chips grow larger in area, the number of FC-BGA units produced from a single wafer sharply declines, worsening the supply-demand imbalance.
key_facts.excerpt: One cause of the shortage is that as AI chips grow larger in area, the number of FC-BGA units produced from a single wafer sharply declines.

key_facts.fact: The company is conducting price renegotiations with major Big Tech customers to reflect rising copper and gold raw material costs and the tight supply-demand situation.
key_facts.excerpt: The company is conducting price renegotiations, including price hikes, with major customers to reflect rising raw material prices for copper and gold as well as the tight supply-demand situation.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Electro-Mechanics plans to more than double this year's capex vs. the prior year, concentrating resources on expanding capacity for high-capacity MLCCs for AI servers and substrates for AI accelerators.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electro-Mechanics said in the conference call that this year's investment will more than double from the previous year... Investment resources will be concentrated on expanding capacity for high-capacity multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs) for AI servers and substrates for AI accelerators.

key_facts.fact: The company launched a new 47uF MLCC product with double the capacity of existing 22uF products, targeting early lead in the AI server platform market.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electro-Mechanics launched a new 47uF (microfarad) product with double the capacity of existing 22uF products, aiming to take an early lead in the AI server platform market.

sources.title: AI-Driven Chip Substrate Shortage Prompts Samsung Electro-Mechanics Price Hike
